mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia increase risk of serotonin syndrome and hyponatremia with duloxetine; duloxetine may increase SIADH risk exacerbating electrolyte derangement.
action: Monitor electrolytes (sodium, potassium) regularly; assess for hyponatremia symptoms; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent; monitor for serotonin syndrome signs.
